conflicts.problem: The lessons give the mkokoteni's acceleration as different values for the same cart on the same escarpment. Lesson 2 uses 2 m/s² (12 m/s after 6 s, 36 m). Lesson 3 implies about 2.5 m/s² (20 m/s after 8 s, 80 m). Lesson 4 uses g = 9.8 m/s² (29.4 m/s after 3 s). Lesson 5 uses g = 10 m/s² (50 m/s after 5 s). Lesson 8 uses about 3 m/s² (40 m/s at the crash point) and says free fall is only the limiting case. Lessons 4 and 5 treat the cart as if in free fall, while Lesson 8 says the slope reduces the acceleration. No single Final Explanation can agree with all of these. Lesson 5 also says to apply 'three' equations and to derive them, while Lesson 2 says there is no derivation and Lessons 2, 3 and 8 say four equations.
